title: Venkatesh Rao argues AI could raise demand for human intelligence
teaser: Venkatesh Rao argues that AI could increase demand for human intelligence rather than make people unnecessary. His comparison is with early capitalism, when people chose to work 300 days a year instead of 250 to afford goods such as tea and sugar. AI, in his view, could make difficult or expensive projects feasible, creating more work for people who can think through them.
